name: US Spot Bitcoin ETF Flows, latest session
description: The newest trading session for US spot Bitcoin ETFs (daily Total, original vendor aggregate and the per-fund breakdown) and the last 5 sessions' totals, newest first. The full series is at https://www.tftc.io/bitcoin-etf-flows/data.json.
attribution: The Commoner Bitcoin ETF Tracker by TFTC, tftc.io/bitcoin-etf-flows
sources: SoSoValue (daily aggregates and per-fund flows); issuer disclosures as tabulated by Farside Investors (per-fund history through mid-2026); mempool.space (BTC price, ~21:00 UTC mark).
totalDefinition: netFlowUsd sums the listed perEtfUsd funds; without a breakdown it uses vendorNetFlowUsd. Known incomplete SoSoValue sessions are withheld. Vendor totals may differ. Displayed figures are rounded.
